mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS device_message ( device_id STRING TAG, id STRING FIELD, upstream INT32 FIELD, reply INT32 FIELD, method STRING FIELD, identifier STRING FIELD, request_id STRING FIELD, server_id STRING FIELD, params STRING FIELD, data STRING FIELD, msg STRING FIELD, report_time STRING FIELD, tenant_id STRING FIELD, code STRING FIELD, raw STRING FIELD )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_message ( time, device_id, id, upstream, reply, method, identifier, request_id, server_id, params, data, msg, report_time, tenant_id, code, raw ) VALUES ( #{ts}, #{deviceId}, #{id}, #{upstream}, #{reply}, #{method}, #{identifier}, #{requestId}, #{serverId}, #{params}, #{data}, #{msg}, #{reportTime}, #{tenantId}, #{code}, #{raw} )
mapper.sql: SELECT time AS ts, device_id, id, upstream, reply, method, identifier, request_id, server_id, params, data, msg, report_time, tenant_id, code, raw FROM device_message
mapper.select:
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
